name: Ensnaring Strike

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a creature with a weapon.

summary: Right after a weapon hit: Str save or the target is Restrained by vines that deal 1d6 Piercing each turn.
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit a creature with a weapon. Thorny vines lash out from the strike, and the target makes a Strength saving throw, with Advantage if it is Large or larger. On a failure it has the Restrained condition until the spell ends; on a success the vines wither and the spell ends. While Restrained this way, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target, or a creature within reach of it, can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC; on a success the vines let go and the spell ends. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
